theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_rectifiable_of_flat_tangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {ν y})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), f z ∂μHE[m]))) → ∃ R : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable m R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0
